title: Ceremony Run-of-Show Timing Model
dataSources: Planning tasks (`event:task`), budget lines (`event:budget`), RSVPs (`event:rsvp`), vendor bookings (`event:vendor`), countdown milestones (`event:countdown`).
app: Wedding and event planning — task and budget spreadsheets, RSVP platforms (Zola, The Knot), vendor contracts, and seating tools — streamed to Splunk HEC via CSV exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=event:countdown milestone_type=ceremony_segment
| stats avg(planned_minutes) as planned_min, avg(actual_minutes) as actual_min by segment
| eval variance_min=round(actual_min-planned_min,1), abs_variance=abs(variance_min)
| sort - abs_variance
description: Compares planned versus actual timing for ceremony segments so your run-of-show gets more realistic.
value: Events run smoother when timelines are calibrated from evidence instead of optimism.
implementation: Log planned and actual minutes for ceremony segments in `event:countdown`; rank them by variance.
visualization: Table of ceremony segments with planned versus actual variance.
grandmaExplanation: It logs which parts of the ceremony usually run longer or shorter than you expected.
